meta.note: Luna theme values lifted from the source CSS. The Light and Dark themes are original to Anarchy. No MSN/Microsoft assets imported. v3 (2026-09-28): warm paper neutrals, vermilion accent, Schibsted Grotesk; away from the zinc/indigo/Inter defaults that read as generated.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panes; body fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes: transcript, file list, forum posts, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Space rail, sidebars, input wells, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and button hover.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row / menu item. The amber selection comes from Luna and is the system's signature.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and surface-selected (≥10:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines: topics, metadata, helper text (≥5.4:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders. Light/dark ≥4.5:1 on surface and canvas. The Luna value is the source's 3.2:1, kept exact: use it only for non-essential metadata.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and pane edges. Decorative only; never the only cue.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (≥3:1 on surface in light/dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand cobalt: primary buttons, links, mentions, active nav indicator.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary hover/pressed.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Mention chips, active nav background, info banners.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text/icons on primary. Dark theme uses near-black because the lighter cobalt fails with white.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Amber accent: unread marker, new-activity dot, the selection edge. Never for warnings.

tokens.name: sealed
tokens.usage: End-to-end encrypted state: lock icon and label on sealed-soft (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: sealed-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the sealed badge and E2EE banners.

tokens.name: public
tokens.usage: Public/discoverable state (forums indexed by search engines). Text on public-soft (≥5:1).

tokens.name: public-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the public badge and the 'this space is public' banner.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Agent identity: role tag text, agent author name.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Agent message tint, approval card fill.

tokens.name: agent-border
tokens.usage: Agent message and approval card edge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, errors, revoke/expire actions.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banners.

tokens.name: presence-online
tokens.usage: Online dot. Always paired with the status word (green/red differ by hue).

tokens.name: presence-away
tokens.usage: Away dot.

tokens.name: presence-busy
tokens.usage: Busy / do-not-disturb dot.

tokens.name: presence-offline
tokens.usage: Offline dot.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (≥6:1 on every ground).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Portal and community landing titles. Luna: 25px bold Tahoma in its brand blue.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog titles, forum thread titles. Luna: 18px.

styles.usage: Pane headers (channel name, folder name). Luna: 13px.

styles.usage: Dialogs, banners, forum post body. Luna: 12px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, row names, nav items. Luna: 11–12px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary row lines, metadata, timestamps. Luna: 11px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase sidebar group headings. Luna: 13px regular, not uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, IRC raw lines, agent tool calls, invite codes.
